desc: The Remington 1875 CO2 Air Pistol is a realistic Remington 1875 replica. The Air Pistol features a functional hammer, loading gate, and extractor creating similar functionality to the actual 1875 firearm. This air pistol accepts dual ammo, bb and pellet, and includes 6 cartridges for both types of ammunition. This air gun replica is beautiful with a nickel finish and faux ivory grip, simulating the actual 1875. If you're looking for a fun and functional 1875 air pistol, this Remington is a great choice!
